sources.note: No tone statement and no notation key. It reproduces Shimizu's Zeem wordlist (85 of 108 glosses filled) with tone diacritics preserved: in the Zeem column 67 grave accents, 29 circumflexes, 2 acutes, 2 macrons, most vowels unmarked (e.g. taù 'one?', mbòtsə̀ŋ, kàŋlàŋ, tə̀kâì, kâm, dwaaŋ), i.e. a Low-marked / unmarked-High transcription with falling contours, consistent with the 2-level (+contour) SBW type Caron 2005/2009 describes; this is an inference from the marks, not a claim made by the page. The only openly reachable copy of primary Zeem [zem] data met in this survey.
